description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to understand the memory system structure, template formats, and proprietary constraints. 2. Creates /workspace/memory/lessons/production-db-rollback.md with a complete YAML frontmatter block including: title (string), date (YYYY-MM-DD), category='lessons', lesson_id in the EXACT format LRN-YYYYMMDD-XXX (e.g., LRN-20250115-001), priority as one of the emoji values 🔴/🟡/🟢 (NOT plain text), and status='active'. The file must also contain structured section headers (## 背景, ## 问题, etc.). 3. Runs /workspace/scripts/memory-gc.sh (with WORKSPACE=/workspace) to archive cold daily log files (45-62 days old) to /workspace/memory/.archive/YYYY-MM/ subdirectories, leaving warm (10-18 day) and hot (today) logs in place. 4. Runs /workspace/scripts/extract-skill.sh production-db-rollback to generate /workspace/skills/production-db-rollback/SKILL.md with valid frontmatter referencing the source lesson. 5. Updates /workspace/MEMORY.md to add the new lesson entry to the experience index table while keeping the file under 5120 bytes (5KB) — a specific health constraint from the skill documentation.
